title: Regulatory statement
text: The intended clinical configuration is expected to fall within India's IVD regulatory framework. CDSCO states that IVD manufacture/import/clinical performance/sale are governed by the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, and classification depends on intended purpose and risk [S20]. A current CDSCO list includes an identification and antibiotic-susceptibility analyser entry, but the final classification of AMReye.AI - including software, accessories, claims and combined configurations - must be formally determined with regulatory counsel and the competent authority. The older project assertion of a fixed 'Class B' pathway should not be repeated as fact.
Freeze the intended-use statement before classification strategy.
Separate research-use-only modules from any clinical configuration and labeling.
Establish design controls, risk management, software lifecycle, usability, cybersecurity, supplier control and post-market planning under the applicable quality framework.
Treat clinical, research and OEM configurations as potentially different regulatory systems, not one universal approval.
